purpose: The add-reaction button at the end of a ReactionGroup row: an icon-only pill that opens the reaction picker and sits in line with the reaction pills.

Default.visual: Border/control edge, Content/secondary icon, no fill.

Hover.visual: Surface/muted fill, Border/control-hover edge, Content/primary icon.

Focused.visual: The Default look plus one 2px Border/ring/default ring 1px outside the pill.

Open.meaning: Its picker is open (set by the popover).
Open.visual: Surface/selected fill, Border/accent edge, Content/accent icon.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it; Space or Enter opens and closes the picker (Radix Popover); Escape closes and returns focus here.
notes: Fill, edge and ink move with the motion role use-hover.

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the use-hover colour transition be dropped, or follow the shortened tokens as ReactionGroup does?
